data.name: Majed
data.gender_notes: Majed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jd', meaning 'to praise' or 'to be glorious'. In Islamic history, Majed is a name given to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) due to his glorified status. The name Majed carries the meaning “Praised, Glorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majed usually hope their child will grow to embody praised, glorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the praiseworthiness of Allah and the recognition of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) status as the best example for Muslims.
data.etymology: Majed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praised, Glorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majed total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
